definitions: 严重破坏；大混乱。常见搭配：wreak havoc，表示“造成严重破坏/引发混乱”。

examples.text: After wreaking havoc across the heavens, pilfering a potion of immortality, and defeating the strongest warriors in the Jade Emperor’s court, the Monkey King had finally been captured in a white-hot prison cell.
examples.explanation: 这里的 havoc 指“严重破坏、混乱”。wreak havoc across the heavens 意思是“在天界造成大乱/严重破坏”，强调孙悟空制造了很大的动荡。

source.text: The tale of the Monkey King and the Buddha - Ji Hao
